case.summary: A $22.74 online transaction on card C07508-K2 by customer C07508 on December 31, 2016, was flagged by the bank's fraud detection system with a high fraud probability of 0.98. The investigation revealed the device used (a MotoG3 Android mobile) had also been used for multiple suspicious transactions on five other cards within the same 24-hour period, and card C07508-K2 itself has a history of 12 prior confirmed fraud cases. The transaction matches the known pattern of card-not-present fraud, and the shared device profile across multiple cards suggests coordinated fraudulent activity. In response, the bank has blocked the card, created an investigation case, placed connected cards under monitoring, and is filing a suspicious activity report.

sar.narrative: On December 31, 2016, at 13:20:31, customer C07508 made an online transaction of $22.74 using card C07508-K2. The transaction was flagged by the bank's fraud detection model with a score of 0.90 and confirmed as fraudulent through subsequent analysis, with a final fraud probability of 0.98. The transaction exhibits characteristics consistent with card-not-present fraud: the card was used online without physical presentation. Investigation revealed the device used (MotoG3 mobile device running Android with Chrome browser, identified as Build/MPIS24.65-33.1-2-16) was active on five other bank cards within the same 24-hour period, conducting transactions of $82.59, $82.65, $22.72, $14.48, $14.48, and $14.38, all of which were flagged as suspicious. Card C07508-K2 carries a history of 12 prior confirmed fraudulent transactions, with the most recent case (CC-5539) also involving card-not-present fraud originating from a new device. The device profile represents a shared origin point for fraudulent activity across multiple cards (C01890-K1, C06663-K2, C07562-K2, C11787-K1, C11847-K2), indicating coordinated fraud activity. The bank has responded by blocking card C07508-K2, creating an investigation case, placing the connected cards under enhanced monitoring, and filing this report in accordance with policy R6 regarding shared device profiles linked to suspicious activity across multiple cards.
